questions.question: How many days of annual leave does a full-time employee receive per year?
questions.answer: Full‑time employees receive **22 working days** of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1]
raw_replies: Full‑time employees receive **22 working days** of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1]

questions.question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry over, and when do they expire?
questions.answer: You may carry over **up to 5 unused annual leave days** into the next calendar year. Those carried‑over days must be used by **31 March** of the following year; otherwise they expire unless the Head of People has approved an exception in writing. [1]
raw_replies: You may carry over **up to 5 unused annual leave days** into the next calendar year. Those carried‑over days must be used by **31 March** of the following year; otherwise they expire unless the Head of People has approved an exception in writing. [1]

questions.question: How far in advance must I request annual leave and who approves it?
questions.answer: You must submit an annual‑leave request at least **10 calendar days before the first day you want off**. The request is then reviewed by your **line manager**, who can approve or decline it within three working days. [1] [2]
raw_replies: You must submit an annual‑leave request at least **10 calendar days before the first day you want off**. The request is then reviewed by your **line manager**, who can approve or decline it within three working days. [1] [5]

questions.question: What is the daily meal reimbursement limit on overnight business trips?
questions.answer: The daily meal reimbursement limit on overnight business trips is **SGD 65 per person per day** (including taxes and service charges)[1].
raw_replies: The daily meal reimbursement limit on overnight business trips is **SGD 65 per person per day** (including taxes and service charges)【1】.

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting a business travel expense claim?
questions.answer: The deadline for submitting a business travel expense claim is within 30 calendar days after returning from the trip. [1]
raw_replies: The deadline for submitting a business travel expense claim is within 30 calendar days after returning from the trip. [1]

questions.question: How much can I claim for a home-office chair and monitor, and how often?
questions.answer: You can claim **up to SGD 400** for a home‑office chair and monitor combined, and the allowance is **reset in a rolling 24‑month period**. The cap covers the total cost of the chair, monitor, desk, keyboard, and mouse, and you must obtain line‑manager approval and submit itemised receipts to Finance. [1]

The cap covers the total cost of the chair, monitor, desk, keyboard, and mouse, and you must obtain line‑manager approval and submit itemised receipts to Finance. [1]

questions.question: How many days a week may eligible employees work remotely?
questions.answer: Eligible employees may work remotely for up to **3 days per week** with written approval from their line manager. [1]
raw_replies: Eligible employees may work remotely for up to **3 days per week** with written approval from their line manager. [1]

questions.question: What hours must remote employees be reachable in Singapore time?
questions.answer: Remote employees must be reachable between **10:00 and 16:00 Singapore time** on their scheduled working days, excluding their normal meal break and any approved appointments. [1]
raw_replies: Remote employees must be reachable between **10:00 and 16:00 Singapore time** on their scheduled working days, excluding their normal meal break and any approved appointments. [1]

questions.question: Who supplies and owns the laptop used for remote work?
questions.answer: The laptop used for remote work is supplied by the company, and IT retains ownership of that managed device. [1]
raw_replies: The laptop used for remote work is supplied by the company, and IT retains ownership of that managed device. [1]

questions.question: What is the minimum password length and is multi-factor authentication required?
questions.answer: The policy requires that company passwords be at least **14 characters long** and that **multi‑factor authentication (MFA) be enabled for all company accounts that support it**. [1]
raw_replies: The policy requires that company passwords be at least **14 characters long** and that **multi‑factor authentication (MFA) be enabled for all company accounts that support it**. [1]

questions.question: How quickly must I report a lost laptop or suspected phishing incident?
questions.answer: You must report a lost laptop or suspected phishing incident within **1 hour of discovery**. [1]
raw_replies: You must report a lost laptop or suspected phishing incident within **1 hour of discovery**. [1]

questions.question: Do I need to use the company VPN to access internal systems from home?
questions.answer: Yes. The Information Security Policy requires that you use the company VPN whenever you access internal systems outside the office, including from home. You should not bypass the VPN or disable security controls; if you encounter problems, contact IT for assistance. [1]

questions.question: What gift value requires a declaration and how long do I have to declare it?
questions.answer: A gift (or hospitality) worth **more than SGD 50** must be declared, and the declaration must be made **within 5 working days** of receiving the offer. [1]

questions.answer: You should disclose the conflict of interest to the **Compliance Lead** before you participate in the supplier selection decision. [1]

questions.question: Who can receive a misconduct report and how quickly is it acknowledged?
questions.answer: Employees may file a misconduct report with their line manager, People Operations, or the Compliance Lead. People Operations acknowledges the report within **2 working days** and then assigns an independent case owner to handle it. [1]
